title: Graph Operators: Union, Products, Contraction for NetworkX Parity
description: Implement mathematical_graph_operators (mathematical/graph/operators/rs/lib.rs) as Wave 2 of the NetworkX-3.6.1-parity effort: set operators (union/disjoint_union/compose/intersection/difference/symmetric_difference), complement/reverse, the four graph products (cartesian/tensor/strong/lexicographic) via node-pair interning, power, contraction (contracted_nodes/contracted_edge/quotient_graph), line_graph, and mycielskian. Single-file crate, generic over Storage<P: PortModel, D: Directedness> from the frozen mathematical_graph core, BTreeMap-based determinism, tests inline at bottom.
